{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''colony''' of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] was founded in the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector]] in the era before the invention of [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] travel. It was later rediscovered during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by operatives of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], who hid the colony before [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] research vessels in the area could find it.<ref name="Follow the Trail">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Follow the Trail}}</ref>
